description: List the categories Signal Lab sorts its 2834 audited hosted MCP servers into (for example stocks and trading, crypto and DeFi, company filings, weather, cybersecurity, maps), with server counts and a page per category. Categories come from fixed keyword rules over each server's listing and tool text, not from an AI model; a server can have up to three. Pass a category slug to find_mcp_servers as category to list its servers.
name: list_mcp_categories
title: List MCP server categories
